verdict.rationale: LangSmith's self-hosting docs describe a Playground service that forwards requests to various LLM APIs, including custom model servers, so prompts can be run against real models. Prompt engineering is also listed as a core platform capability. The evidence is thin, though: it comes from an infrastructure page rather than dedicated playground docs, and says nothing about the iteration workflow or variable templating. Missing for 10: evidence of prompt variables/templating in the playground, documentation of the iterative editing and comparison workflow, independent or hands-on corroboration.
